LESSON: READING 2.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Activities in the Home Suggested vocabulary clean, wash, sweep, water, feed, car
Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 2.2.1 Fluency, part of Activities in the Home Suggested vocabulary clean, wash, sweep, water, feed, car in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we show feelings when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch or listen to a video clip on reading fluency and respond to questions from the teacher and peers.

2. pick out words featuring the target letter-sound combinations: /cl/ and /ɔʊ/ from various texts.

3. practice reading a short print or digital text or braille text featuring words with the target blend expressively and fluently.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch or listen to a video clip on reading fluency and respond to questions from the teacher and peers.
2. pick out words featuring the target letter-sound combinations: /cl/ and /ɔʊ/ from various texts.
3. practice reading a short print or digital text or braille text featuring words with the target blend expressively and fluently.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 2.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn; Independent learning is developed as the learner practices reading texts with peers for fluency.

Values

Respect; Acceptance is shown as the learner appreciates diverse opinions from others.

Values:
Respect; Acceptance is shown as the learner appreciates diverse opinions from others.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: The learner’ self-esteem is nurtured when they are able to read a text fluently.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Reading fluency is a key skill in all learning areas.
